comments.dependencies: Frontend vendor libraries served to the browser. The build.xml Ant target copies these from node_modules into resources/{js,css,fonts}/external (scripts/copy-vendor-libs.js) - split by file type so a stylesheet's relative url()s to its own images/fonts still resolve; fontawesome's webfonts are the one exception, pulled into resources/fonts/external with a rewritten url() since nothing else needed its own css-adjacent font folder.
comments.font-awesome: Consolidated onto @fortawesome/fontawesome-free@7.3.1 everywhere (previously split 4.7.0/5.7.2). All icon markup was rewritten to explicit fas/far classes and current icon names (see shims.yml-derived mapping in the PR) - no v4-shims.css dependency.
comments.d3: Two d3 majors are both in use: d3@5.16.0 (d3.v5) backs items/permanentItems; d3-v3 is an npm alias for d3@3.5.17 (d3.v3), used only by templates/sparql.html. Both kept, pinned, to preserve current per-page behavior.
comments.jquery: Bumped 1.11.1 -> 3.7.1 (+ jquery-migrate 1.2.1 -> 3.6.0) to close known XSS CVEs fixed in jQuery 3.5.0+. Stayed on the 3.x line rather than 4.0 because the vendored plugins (jQuery UI 1.13, DataTables 1.13, slick-carousel, virtual-keyboard) are untested against 4.0's IE11 drop and thinner migrate shims. datatables.net/-bs bumped 1.10.9 -> 1.13.11 in the same pass to close a separate high-severity prototype-pollution/XSS advisory; still the 1.x line, pre-ESM rewrite, same dist file layout.
comments.d3-color-audit: npm audit still flags a d3-color ReDoS (GHSA-36jr-mh4h-2g58) transitively via d3@5.16.0. Deliberately NOT using an npm override to silence it: we vendor d3's prebuilt dist/d3.min.js as-is (see copy-vendor-libs.js), which bundles its own copy of d3-color at publish time and ignores whatever version node_modules/d3-color resolves to - an override only fixes what `npm audit` reports, not the actual bytes we ship. d3 never back-patched this into a 5.x release, so the real fix needs the d3 6/7 major jump, out of scope for this pass.

scripts.deploy:dev: ant && EXISTDB_SERVER=http://localhost:8080 EXISTDB_USER=admin EXISTDB_PASS= xst package install local-files build/*.xar
